description: A classically styled kitchen with high ceilings and a warm cream palette throughout. The cabinetry is painted a warm off-white or creamy ivory in a raised-panel Shaker profile, fitted with polished brass bar pulls on the lower drawers and brass cup pulls above. Upper glass-front cabinets on the right reveal stacks of white dinnerware within. A marble or quartz countertop in white with subtle veining extends across the island and perimeter surfaces. The backsplash is matching white marble tile. A farmhouse undermount sink is visible at the back counter with a brushed brass arc faucet. Three upholstered barstools with grey linen seats on matte black legs line one side of the island. The island itself is styled with a tall clear glass vase of white hydrangeas and green botanical stems, and a small matte black footed bowl. To the left, two large arched black steel-framed multi-pane windows with pointed arched tops bring in bright diffuse daylight. The floor is a rich dark espresso-stained wide-plank hardwood. Applied crown moulding trims the upper perimeter. At the right, an arched doorway opens to a softly lit adjacent room. The atmosphere is elegant and bright, formal yet livable, with a classic American kitchen character.
